agents.desc: Use the OpenAI-compatible provider, the Vancine base URL, and an environment-backed key.
clineSteps: Choose OpenAI Compatible as the API provider.
Set the base URL to https://vancine.com/v1 and use your VANCINE_API_KEY.
Select kimi-k3 as the model ID.
